name: BlockIT
lines: A clearer view of your disk.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Drive or folder] --> B[Metadata scanner worker]
  B --> C[(SQLite scan index)]
  C --> D[Query worker]
  D --> E[React views and treemap]
  A --> F[Filename index worker]
  F --> G[Explorer search]
boundary: Scans file metadata; filename search does not inspect document contents.

name: CircuitSleuth
lines: Inspect the board. Question the evidence.
Adaptive PCB inspection with human review.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Reference and test board] --> B{Registration valid?}
  B -->|No| C[NOT_EVALUABLE]
  B -->|Yes| D[Detect candidate regions]
  D --> E[Agent chooses verification tool]
  E --> F{Enough evidence?}
  F -->|More needed| E
  F -->|Yes| G[Verdict with evidence]
  F -->|Capture needed| H[Operator review / new capture]
boundary: Collaborative project. Published benchmark uses seeded synthetic boards; it is not factory accuracy.

name: Takumi
lines: Capture the reasoning behind expert work.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Expert recording] --> B[Local transcription]
  B --> C[Lesson extraction adapter]
  C --> D[Validate transcript evidence]
  D --> E[Expert edits and approves]
  E --> F[Versioned lesson]
  F --> G[Guided practice and attempts]
boundary: Hosted browser demo uses a bundled sample. Custom uploads and AI processing require the local backend.

name: OpenDoor
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Authorized verification plan] --> B[Deterministic call fixture]
  B --> C[Evidence-linked candidate facts]
  C --> D[Quarantine conflicts]
  D --> E[Human field decisions]
  E --> F[Atomic version check]
  F --> G[(D1 revision + audit event)]
boundary: The demonstrated review flow uses simulated calls. Live CALL-E creation is not a validated end-to-end integration.

name: Synapse Memory Lab
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Deterministic token stream] --> B[Read prior memory]
  B --> C[Outer-product state update]
  C --> D[Neuron and synapse canvases]
  B --> E[Explicit-history comparison]
  C --> F[Load and interference experiment]
boundary: Collaborative educational toy simulations; no official BDH checkpoint or trained-model benchmark is run.

name: RetailPulse AI
lines: From retail tables to customer insight.
Explain the segments behind the numbers.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Customers / products / sales] --> B[Validate relational data]
  B --> C[RFM and behavioral features]
  C --> D[Compare clustering models]
  D --> E[Interpretable segment profiles]
  D --> F[Segment-assignment classifier]
  E --> G[Export analysis artifacts]
boundary: Classifier evaluation measures agreement with the selected segmentation model, not causal business lift.
